assets.name: brand-icon
assets.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. For SeeWord, a video-based English learning web app. A unified restrained flat editorial illustration system. Palette: saturated learning blue #0071e3, deep navy #12355b, pale sky #e8f2fd, warm off-white #fff8ef. Crisp geometric shapes, rounded corners and smooth curves, flat solid fills, consistent navy outline where appropriate. No 3D, no gradients, no textures, no typography, no letters, no watermark, no extra decorative stars. Clear at tiny UI sizes. Square image, artwork fills the canvas with sensible edge margin. Asset type: app and browser icon. Primary request: one bold solid blue speech bubble with softly rounded corners and a small lower-left tail. A single warm-white right-facing play triangle is cut into its center. Simple unmistakable silhouette combining dialogue and video, strong optical balance. Background: transparent, outside the speech bubble completely empty. Bubble occupies about 84 percent of the square width; use no outer tile, no drop shadow. The graphic must work at 16 pixels.
